investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Mercrest Press (news and media publishing); Platform: Microsoft Azure uksouth (zones uksouth-1/uksouth-2/uksouth-3); network range 10.192.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster mercre-prod-uksout (AKS); External dependency: fx-svc calls a FX rates API (fx.ratebridge.io) protected by a circuit breaker; external synthetic probes monitor public dependencies; Change management: production changes carry CR- identifiers.
